column1: Yordan Alvarez leads the slate with a strong hit probability and a clear platoon advantage at home against Sean Burke, pairing steady season-long contact with a recent uptick at the plate. Jeremy Pena offers similar reliability in the leadoff spot, reaching base in nearly three-quarters of his games and facing the same favorable pitching matchup. Ronald Acuna Jr. and Mauricio Dubon also benefit from platoon edges, but Alvarez’s consistency and matchup make him the top pick for Beat The Streak players tonight.
